_meta.how: real forgectl run through pr-comment's own gateway, scratch HOME and XDG, no credentials, PATH with only an empty directory (no gh or glab); every case ends before a host is read. A case with stdin_unread true left at least 8 MiB of its stdin unread. To regenerate: for each case, build a ProcessGateway(forgectl_bin=<absolute pinned forgectl>, environ=<HOME and XDG_*_HOME in a fresh private directory, PATH=one empty absolute directory>) and call gateway.call(argv[0], argv[1:] without --json, stdin=<stdin bytes> when the arguments carry '-'); record a result of exit 12 with error code tool_missing as {reaches_host: true, expect: {reaches_host: true}}, any other as expect {exit, stdout (parsed JSON), stderr}, with stdin_unread true when the result says forgectl left its stdin unread; write the file with json.dumps(document, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) plus a newline (a test checks that byte for byte). GitLab cases use the placeholder host gitlab.com/g/s/r#1.
